AI Overview
Rocket Fortress is a fast-paced clicker RPG defense game published by AZGames. 
Rocket Fortress
Core Gameplay
Objective: Defend your base from endless waves of demonic invaders, portals, and giant bosses.
Controls: Click the left mouse button or press the Spacebar to launch holy missiles. Rapid tapping increases your attack rate.
Units & Support: Recruit auto-firing marines and supporting troops to defend your base even when you are not actively clicking.
Power-ups: Use special abilities like laser locks and temporary boosts to deal massive area damage during tough fights. 
Rocket Fortress
 +1
Progression & Upgrades
Resources: Defeating enemies, destroying portals, clicking the Box Fairy, and fighting in dungeons earns you minerals, diamonds, coins, and uranium.
Upgrades: Spend collected resources to upgrade your missile damage, launcher power, marine strength, and fortress defenses.
Bosses: Face off against a major boss every 10 portals destroyed.
